title: Chapter 1328 - 11: Another Bout With The Demon God
content:
Chapter 1328 - 11: Another Bout With The Demon God

Chapter 1328: Chapter 11: Another Bout with the Demon God

In fact, this is also the normal method for a new Eternal Lord to be born in this Fang Yuan World, aiming to completely eliminate the demonic disaster.

First, one must take action against the endless Demonic Qi, extinguishing it, and together with the consciousness of the source world, suppress the Demon God.

During this process, the resistance and struggle from the demon form will be encountered, but as long as stability is maintained, the final outcome will undoubtedly be favorable to the side of the source world.

...

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly, and a Tai Chi Diagram covering a hundred billion miles appeared in the sky, beginning to rotate slowly, extinguishing a vast amount of Demonic Qi.

Not long after.

The Demonic Qi permeating the entire source world began to boil.

Obviously, the Demon God clearly sensed something and began to reveal its true form.

In the center of the world, the hidden realm.

Several Sect Masters of the Eternal Sect also sensed the changes in the Demonic Qi.

"What’s happening? The Demon God has appeared again?"

"How long has it been since the last appearance?"

"It shouldn’t be like this."

"The Demon God’s appearance isn’t at the center of the world."

"It’s Lord Galaxy, the Demon God is targeting Lord Galaxy again."

The few Sect Masters looked tense, as they didn’t perceive Lin Yuan actively forcing the Demon God to show itself.

After all, the amount of Demonic Qi Lin Yuan had extinguished wasn’t much, yet it was enough to be detected by the Demon God, not causing much commotion.

The Sect Masters and several high-level elders from the sect subconsciously thought, could it be that the Demon God had found a way to deal with Lin Yuan and now planned to suppress him.

Should Lin Yuan be suppressed, the strongholds of the great Eternal Sect would undoubtedly not be spared.

If it weren’t for Lin Yuan holding the front line ten thousand years ago, the hidden realm would have long been trampled by the Demon God.

"I hope Lord Galaxy is prepared."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect prayed in secret, while also ready to activate the Eternal Treasure with the other few Sect Masters at any time to support Lin Yuan when necessary.

...

Outside the source world.

Thirteen Eternal Lords who were fully resisting the infinite light also discovered the commotion in the source world at the first moment.

"Is it Galaxy extinguishing the Demonic Qi?"

Compared to the Sect Masters in the hidden realm, the Thirteen Eternal Lords immediately determined the true reason for the Demon God’s appearance.

It was Lin Yuan who took the initiative.

"Galaxy is too impatient, trying to extinguish the Demonic Qi now to end the demonic disaster is easily subject to the Demon God’s backlash resistance."

The Master of Black Space frowned, this was also the result of their previous observation of Lin Yuan’s various future timelines.

The Master of Infinite had specifically reminded Lin Yuan of this matter, advising him not to act rashly.

Lin Yuan was different from a normal Eternal Lord, his strengths were comparable to an Eternal Lord,

but he was not yet an Eternal Lord, still having a vast potential for strength enhancement.

Other Eternal Lords might need to pay a long-lasting price to end the demonic disaster.

This was inevitable.

However, Lin Yuan could completely wait until crossing into the Thirteenth Rank before gradually resolving the situation.

The transition from the Twelfth Rank to the Thirteenth Rank is a significant qualitative leap in the essence of life.

By then, his strength would also soar.

Ending the demonic disaster with the strongest stance would be not only more efficient but also potentially reduce the cost he needs to pay.

After all, the real identity of the Demon God is the true form of a Time Lord, who knows what hidden means might be kept.

"Maybe Galaxy has a deeper reason for acting this way?"

The Master of Wushan said, as now they couldn’t directly observe Lin Yuan’s future timeline, making it hard to judge the outcome of this re-encounter with the Demon God against him, they could only rely on the experience gained from the previously observed future timelines.

"Since Galaxy wants to continue clashing with the Demon God, then let them fight, it won’t affect the overall situation anyway."

The Master of Infinite thought for a moment and spoke.

Even if the worst outcome observed in the future timelines comes to pass, which is being subjected to the Demon God’s backlash, delaying his time to become an Eternal Lord by tens of thousands of years.

Whether it’s tens of thousands of years earlier or later to become an Eternal Lord, it doesn’t make much difference to the present Eternal Lords.

"Besides, I agree with Wushan’s view, Galaxy should be very confident by acting this way."

The Master of Infinite spoke, although their time with Lin Yuan was not long, they had observed many future timelines, and understood this future Eternal Lord destined to save the world quite well.

From what was seen of Lin Yuan’s various actions in the future timelines, his character should be very cautious and wouldn’t do things he wasn’t confident about.

"Indeed."

The other Eternal Lords nodded slightly upon hearing this.

The main point is that Galaxy’s future is too certain, even if he chooses the most disadvantageous scenario for himself, it would only delay becoming an Eternal Lord by a few tens of thousands of years.

The cost of this is insignificant to the present Eternal Lords.

"Let’s see how Galaxy and the Demon God clash."

With a slight movement of thought, oscillations appeared before the Master of Infinite, presenting a series of images, exactly the scene where Lin Yuan stood up.

In the distance, boundless Demonic Qi gathered, forming the silhouette of the Demon God.

...

"Finally revealed."

Lin Yuan looked distantly at the re-manifested Demon God.

It bore a single black horn, and behind it swung a thick black giant tail.

The Demonic Qi covering the entire source world surged with every breath of the Demon God.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan clearly noticed that the Demon God appearing this time was somewhat different from when they first met.

If when he first met this Demon God, there was not a trace of instinctual fluctuation, even when Lin Yuan erupted with terrifying power, it hadn’t caused much change in the Demon God.

Then now.

Lin Yuan sensed a kind of instinct almost overflowing from the Demon God.

Desire.

Desire.

Desire.

The Demon God looked at Lin Yuan with eyes full of a certain desire, wanting to devour him entirely.

"Is it because of my Lord Rank?"

Lin Yuan speculated the reason; the Lord Rank he had condensed originated from the Lord of Heaven Light.

While the Demon God was the black demon form of the Lord of Heaven Light, naturally extremely desiring for the Lord Rank of the Lord of Heaven Light.

It’s just that the Lord of Heaven Light failed to break into the Fourteenth Rank, as his mental consciousness burned out, causing the collapse of the Lord Rank, scattering into the bloodline of all beings in this source world.

Common methods could not extract it out.

The Demon God, using its own Demonic Qi, nurtured countless ’demons’, launching a savage slaughter on the beings of the source world.

With the idea of devouring the beings of this source world, ultimately re-condensing the Lord Rank.

With the ’compatibility’ between the Demon God and the Lord Rank, if it truly gathered the Lord Rank again, its strength would surely increase significantly.

"Come, let me see your true strength."

Lin Yuan’s figure expanded instantly, standing towering above all, revealing his true form, overlooking the ’tiny’ Demon God.

In the previous encounter, Lin Yuan clearly felt that the Demon God had more means it hadn’t used, only retreating after realizing it couldn’t completely deal with Lin Yuan.

Rumbling~ The Demon God’s form also began to expand madly, its long black robe fluttering, the endless demonic darkness naturally spreading out, transforming into a deep night sky, actively covering towards Lin Yuan.

At this moment.

A gigantic tail tearing through space swept over in an instant, cloaked by the canopy formed by endless Demonic Qi, but the true means of the Demon God’s attack was these sweeping giant tails.

The terrifying giant tail carried an overwhelming force, where it swept past, time and space were obliterated on a large scale, this strike, its power far exceeded the tail swipe from the previous encounter.

Because of Lin Yuan’s Lord Rank, the Demon God’s unprecedented devour instinct emerged, at this moment, its impulse to devour Lin Yuan was as strong as suppressing the consciousness of the source world, naturally holding nothing back in its tail swipe.

Just then.

An enormous tail that tore through spacetime swept in an instant, using the curtain formed by endless demonic Qi as cover, targeting Lin Yuan.

The fearsome strength constantly dissolved and collided, but bearing the brunt of the Demon God’s tail sweep, Lin Yuan easily remained standing still in the distance.

The infinite Constant Sand Particle Worlds within swiftly dispersed the attack it took, and each particle world easily withstood the blow.

"Is this move just meant to scratch an itch?" Lin Yuan looked at the Demon God.
